title: Finance Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About much. GmbH

much. Consulting is an ERP & automation consultancy with 120 people in Germany, Portugal and the UK. We grow fast and profitable, which gives us room to make bold moves. Next up: building a finance function that matches our size and starting to acquire competitors.

The role


You join as the first finance manager of the group and report directly to the CEO. Your job is to take our finance function to the next level and kickstart our M&A. You work with a small team and our external tax advisors (in all countries) and a lot of freedom in how you build things. Nothing is set in stone and much needs improvement. You'll build processes from scratch, fix what's broken yourself and decide what's worth doing at all.

What you will do

  • Develop and control cash plan, business plan and budgets

  • Be our treasurer, find savings in our cost base and see them through

  • Maintain transfer pricing and intercompany agreements together with our advisors

  • Support on acquisitions: financial models, due diligence and integrating new companies into group reporting

What you bring

  • 2 to 5 years in audit, transaction services or finance at a growing company

  • Deep accounting and controlling knowledge, ideally across multiple countries

  • You learn fast and enjoy taking on things you haven't done before

  • You act like it's your own money

  • You'd rather build the cash forecast yourself than write a concept for it

  • You prefer working with data in systems over manual processes; SQL or ERP experience helps

  • Fluent in English and German (both min. C1)

What we offer

  • Contribute to every major decision

  • Short decision paths. If you have a good idea on Monday, it can be live by Friday.

  • A role that grows with the group

  • Office in Munich, hybrid with 2 home office days per week

  • 80k€ fixed salary plus an annual performance bonus tied to clear, jointly defined goals

We have much. to do.

Apply now!

ProcuVia ist eine spezialisierte Einkaufsberatung. Wir verbinden Einkaufsexpertise mit Datenanalyse und KI und begleiten unsere Kunden bei der praktischen Umsetzung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du stellst passende ProcuVia-Leistungen vor, erkennst weiterführenden Beratungsbedarf und vereinbarst den nächsten Schritt mit dem zuständigen Kollegen.
  • Du testest neue KI-Anwendungen, bildest dich laufend weiter und entwickelst unser Workshop-Angebot zwischen den Kundeneinsätzen mit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer relevanten KI-Umgebung, etwa Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude oder Perplexity. Weitere Plattformen erschließt du dir eigenständig.

title: Co-Founder & COO (m/w/d) gesucht für Corporate Philanthropy Plattform | Düsseldorf/Remote
description:
Über Bonoboo


Bei Bonoboo bauen wir die Plattform für Corporate Philanthropy. Mit KI-gestütztem Matchmaking verbinden wir Unternehmen gezielt mit passenden gemeinnützigen Organisationen. Das Ziel: messbare Wirkung, effizientere Spendenprozesse und datenbasiertes gesellschaftliches Engagement. Wir sind ein wachsendes, internationales Team mit Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf und wollen die Spendenbranche nachhaltig verändern.

Wo wir stehen
Unser Produkt ist validiert, und erste Unternehmen setzen Bonoboo bereits zahlend ein. Wir sind mitten in der Pre-Seed-Phase, mehrere Business Angels sind an Bord, und das Kapital für die nächsten Schritte ist gesichert. Jetzt geht es darum, aus einem funktionierenden Produkt ein skalierendes Unternehmen zu machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Wer wir sind

  • Julia, CEO & Founder: bringt Expertise in Sales und Finance mit und verantwortet Vertrieb, Finanzen und Fundraising.

  • Max, CTO & Co-Founder: hat Erfahrung als KI-Entwickler und verantwortet Produkt und Tech.

Was uns noch fehlt, ist die Person, die den Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo nicht nur mitdenkt, sondern operativ führt und nach außen trägt.

Deine Aufgaben als Co-Founder & COO

Du verantwortest den gesamten Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres Start-ups maßgeblich mit.

Strategie & Impact
Du denkst mit uns die großen Fragen: Wie skaliert Corporate Philanthropy? Wo hebeln wir Wirkung am stärksten? Du bringst strategische Klarheit in ein Feld, das oft unscharf bleibt.

Operative Leitung Impact
Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für alles, was mit Impact zu tun hat, von Prozessen bis zur Reporting-Logik. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Vision gelebte Praxis wird.

NGO-Partnernetzwerk & Success Management
Du baust unser Netzwerk an NGO-Partner:innen auf und pflegst es. Du verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften auf der Plattform für beide Seiten wirklich funktionieren.

Bühne & Pitches
Du bist eines der Gesichter von Bonoboo: auf Startup-Bühnen, bei Pitches und im Gespräch mit Kund:innen, Partner:innen und Investor:innen. Du erzählst unsere Story mit Substanz, Überzeugung und Begeisterung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in Strategy, Business Development oder Operations, idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu CSR, HR oder dem NGO-Sektor

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du treibst Dinge eigenständig voran und baust Prozesse und Strukturen auf, statt nur darüber zu reden.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du begeisterst andere für Impact-Themen, auf der Bühne genauso überzeugend wie im 1:1 mit unseren NGO-Partner:innen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung für das Ganze übernehmen und Bonoboo gemeinsam mit uns aufbauen und skalieren.

  • Leidenschaft für Impact: Du glaubst daran, dass Unternehmen und NGOs gemeinsam mehr bewegen können, wenn die Partnerschaft wirklich passt.

Deine ersten Monate

In den ersten drei bis sechs Monaten baust du unser NGO-Partnernetzwerk systematisch aus. Du setzt die Prozesse für Matching und Impact Reporting auf und stehst bei den ersten Pitches mit auf der Bühne. Gemeinsam mit Julia und Max legst du fest, wie Bonoboo im nächsten Jahr wachsen soll.

Das bieten wir

  1. Teil des Gründungsteams: Anteile, Mitsprache und Einfluss auf die Richtung des Unternehmens. Bonoboo wird auch dein Unternehmen.

  2. Flexibles Arbeiten: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitstag selbst und arbeitest dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Für die wichtigen Momente treffen wir uns regelmäßig in Düsseldorf.

  3. Raum zum Wachsen: Austausch mit unseren Business Angels und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk für deine persönliche und unternehmerische Entwicklung.

  4. Ein modernes Software-Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Impact

  5. Ein Team, das schnell entscheidet und mit Leidenschaft arbeitet

  6. Die Chance, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten und Corporate Philanthropy neu zu denken

Vergütung

3.000–6.000 € brutto im Monat, plus Unternehmensanteile. Die konkrete Beteiligung legen wir gemeinsam im Kennenlernprozess fest.

So lernen wir uns kennen

  1. Erstes Gespräch: lockeres Kennenlernen. Wer bist du, wer sind wir, passt das grundsätzlich?

  2. Zweites Gespräch: Wir steigen tiefer ein, in Impact, Strategie und deine fachliche Perspektive auf Bonoboo.

  3. Drittes Treffen, gerne persönlich in Düsseldorf: Wir lernen uns auf persönlicher Ebene kennen und sprechen über Anteile und die Rahmenbedingungen.

Klingt nach dir? Dann melde dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

description:

  • Relazioni con gli Influencer (Italia): Ricerca, negoziazione e gestione delle partnership con beauty influencer e content creator italiani, dal briefing iniziale al completamento della campagna e al monitoraggio delle prestazioni.

  • Pianificazione e creazione di contenuti: Ideazione e creazione a 360° — pianificazione, ripresa e montaggio di contenuti video e fotografici originali e coinvoggenti, pensati specificamente per la community italiana.

  • Gestione dei canali: Presa in carico progressiva, sia strategica che operativa, di specifici canali social (es. TikTok o Pinterest) per il mercato italiano.

  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (obbligatorio): Eccellenti competenze di comunicazione scritta e verbale in italiano, con una naturale familiarità con il linguaggio del settore beauty e il tono di voce dei clienti.

  • Social & Marketing al centro: I nostri canali digitali sono fondamentali per la crescita del brand — il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto immediato e visibile sul mercato italiano.

  • Ambiente di lavoro moderno: Stipendio competitivo, orari di lavoro flessibili, sconti per i dipendenti e attrezzatura di lavoro moderna.

  • Prospettive a lungo termine: Chiare opportunità di avanzamento di carriera e di inserimento a tempo indeterminato.

Ti sembra il ruolo giusto per te? Se hai motivazione, idee e voglia di far crescere il nostro brand in Italia, saremmo felicissimi di ricevere la tua candidatura! Anche se non soddisfi ancora tutti i requisiti indicati, ti incoraggiamo comunque a candidarti: premiamo la determinazione, la curiosità e un'attitudine positiva.

Invia il tuo CV, una breve lettera di presentazione e (se disponibili) i link al tuo portfolio, a lavori svolti o ai tuoi profili social.

title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.

This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.

Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Your Mission

Financial Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.
  • Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations.
  • Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.
  • Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments.
  • Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
  • Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

  • Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
  • Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
  • Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.
  • Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

  • Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials.
  • Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy.
  • Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

  • Own Finance processes across all markets.
  • Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries.
  • Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

  • Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
  • Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
  • Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
  • Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
  • Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Proven leadership experience in a scale-up, high-growth, or international environment.
  • Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering.
  • Experience building and professionalising Finance functions and processes.
  • Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level.
  • High degree of ownership and proactiveness.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design.
  • Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes.

Languages:

  • Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:

  • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes

  • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction

  • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions

  • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive

🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
  • Two Community Days per calendar year
  • Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

When you apply, we focus solely on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (photo, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc.). We value and treat all applications equally.

title: Working Student Marketing & Content (m/w/d)
description:
Unsere Mission

Neue Kunden zu gewinnen ist für viele kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen zeitaufwendig und teuer. selqo wurde gegründet, um genau diesen Unternehmen die Möglichkeit zu geben, planbar und kosteneffizient zu wachsen. Dafür entwickeln wir eine KI-basierte Plattform, mit der kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen automatisiert passende Zielkunden finden, sie persönlich ansprechen und nachfassen können, bis aus Kontakten neue Kunden werden.

Deine Aufgabe

Wie selqo im Markt wahrgenommen wird, entscheidet sich jetzt. Dafür suchen wir eine Werkstudentin oder einen Werkstudenten, die oder der Seite an Seite mit unserem Gründerteam die Marke selqo von Grund auf mitgestaltet: unsere Geschichte erzählt, Kundenerfolge sichtbar macht und unseren Auftritt auf LinkedIn und in Kampagnen prägt.

  • Du planst und schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge für die Profile unserer Gründer und für die selqo-Unternehmensseite.

  • Du führst Interviews mit unseren Kunden und machst daraus überzeugende Case Studies.

  • Du gestaltest Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos für LinkedIn und unsere Werbekampagnen.

  • Du bereitest unsere Inhalte für Blog und Newsletter auf und baust beides Schritt für Schritt aus.

  • Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und hilfst so, unsere Kommunikation weiterzuentwickeln.

Was diese Stelle besonders macht

  • Etwas Neues mitprägen: Mit selqo geben wir jedem KMU die Möglichkeit planbar und effizient zu wachsen. Du definierst wie wir darüber sprechen, und prägst damit nicht nur unsere Marke, sondern einen ganzen Markt.

  • Direkt mit dem Gründerteam: Du arbeitest täglich mit uns drei Gründern zusammen, ohne Hierarchie dazwischen. Du sitzt mit am Tisch, wenn wir über Positionierung, Zielgruppen und Kampagnen entscheiden.

  • Maßgeblicher Einfluss von Tag eins: Du bist die erste Person im Marketing. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament, auf dem unser künftiges Marketingteam aufsetzt.

  • Spannende Geschichten: Du sprichst mit Unternehmern aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und erzählst, wie sie mit selqo neue Kunden gewinnen.

Dein Profil

Erfahrung

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft oder Medien.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau: klar, verständlich und ohne Floskeln.

  • Du hast schon eigene Projekte umgesetzt, zum Beispiel einen Social-Media-Kanal, einen Blog oder ein kleines Business.

Mindset

  • Du packst Dinge an, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich und bist neugierig auf neue Formate.

  • Du interessierst dich für B2B, Vertrieb und den Mittelstand.

  • Du hast Lust, mit einem jungen Start-up zu wachsen und die Marke von Anfang an mitzuprägen.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Chance, ein Startup, das einen neue Kategorie prägt, von Anfang an maßgeblich mitzugestalten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam und Einblick in alle Bereiche, von Produkt über Vertrieb bis Finanzierung

  • Attraktive Vergütung von 20 € pro Stunde bei 16–20 Stunden pro Woche

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

  • Arbeitsplatz in Paderborn

  • Die Aussicht, nach dem Studium mit uns weiterzuwachsen und das Marketing mit aufzubauen

Bewerbung

Schick uns einfach einen kurzen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Sätze zu deinen bisherigen Projekten mit Marketingbezug.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen jeden Hintergrunds, Geschlechts, Alters und jeder Herkunft.

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten.

Benefits

  • Sie übernehmen ein funktionierendes Geschäftsmodell mit bestehender Infrastruktur, laufenden Kundenbeziehungen und Cashflow – eine grundsätzlich andere Ausgangslage als eine Neugründung auf der grünen Wiese.

  • Gutes Betriebsklima, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Einstieg als geschäftsführender Gesellschafter im Rahmen einer vollständigen Übernahme – begleitet von einer geordneten Übergabephase mit dem heutigen Inhaber.

Und wichtig für alle, die über eine Übernahme bisher nicht nachgedacht haben: Ein solcher Schritt finanziert sich in aller Regel aus einer Kombination von Eigenkapital, Bankdarlehen und dem laufenden Ertrag des Betriebs. Vollständige belastbare Geschäftszahlen legen wir im persönlichen Gespräch bzw. nach einer Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung offen. Wer ernsthaftes Interesse hat, soll früh wissen, worauf er sich einlässt.

title: Senior Agronomist - Digital Agronomist Products (all genders)
description:
The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission:

You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform.

You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendations and assessments - cover crop mixes, tillage transitions, rotation changes, nutrient decisions - and judge whether a given recommendation makes sense for a given soil, location and goal.

  • Translate agronomy into buildable products. Turn agronomic principles into clear product and engineering specifications.

  • Bring empathy to the farmer’s context into our products. What is going on around our product for the farmers, what data are accessible and reasonable to ask for, what value we can deliver back to famers.

  • Act as a sparring partner to product, design and modelling. Challenge assumptions, find the gaps in our thinking, and say when an approach won't land with a farmer.

  • Challenge models and outputs against field reality. You dig into the numbers, spot what doesn't add up, and explain why a result contradicts what you would expect from experience.

  • Think like the farm owner, not just the agronomist. Tell us where farmers will hesitate, what proof they'll ask for, and what makes the change worth it to them, in money and beyond.

  • Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products.

  • Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

  • Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

  • Support expansion into new regions by working out how farming systems differ and what that means for our recommendations.

Your profile:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role where you carried responsibility for real decisions on real farms.

  • You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline. A strong practical track record can stand in its place.

  • You have strong, hands-on experience in open-field arable systems (cereals, oilseeds, root crops) in temperate Europe.

  • You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.

  • You have proven hands-on farm economics experience. You have built an investment case alongside a farmer and know which arguments actually convince, and which don't.

  • You combine regenerative conviction with practical judgment. You believe in regenerative impact and know what farmers will realistically adopt: no evangelism, no greenwashing.

  • You are interested in technology. You have used farm software, and follow what is happening in the space and believe in the potential but also see the issues.

  • You can find your way around a spreadsheet or a set of performance figures and spot where the logic breaks.

  • You have a creative spark. Given a half-formed idea, you improve it rather than only evaluate it.

Languages

  • Fluent English and fluent German. Most of our farmers are German, and you will be talking to them, reading their feedback and reviewing German farmer-facing copy. Experience of the German market is a strong advantage.

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits for Germany-based employees: We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.

Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team.

Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.

  • Du baust unsere UGC-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen.

  • Du bringst 5.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“).

  • Du machst aus unseren Beta-Familien Fans: Reviews, Videos, Testimonials, echte Geschichten.

  • Du baust den Funnel von Warteliste bis Abo: Landingpage, Shop, E-Mail-Flows, Empfehlungsprogramm, Abo-Aktivierung, Kündigungs-Prävention.

  • Du schaltest Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) selbst, misst sauber (Tracking, Attribution, CAC, LTV) und entscheidest nach Zahlen.

  • Du bringst uns in die Magazine, Podcasts und Feeds, die Eltern in DACH wirklich lesen und hören.

  • Du machst die Gründer sichtbar (LinkedIn, Instagram) – vor dem Launch unser günstigster Kanal.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Marketing hält, was das Produkt verspricht: keine Kinder als Werbefiguren, Datenschutz vorgelebt, Werbung sauber gekennzeichnet, kein Fake-UGC.

  • Du hast ein Krisen-Playbook in der Schublade, falls Onoo einem Kind mal etwas Falsches sagt.

  • Du baust ab dem Launch das Team und holst Freelancer und Agenturen dazu, wo es sich lohnt.

Melde dich, wenn:

  • Du 5+ Jahre Consumer-Marketing gemacht hast, am liebsten D2C mit Abo oder Hardware.

  • Du schon mal eine Marke von null aufgebaut hast oder beim Aufbau ganz vorne dabei warst.

  • Du UGC nicht nur kennst, sondern eine Creative-Testing-Maschine gebaut hast und uns sagen kannst, welche Hook-Rate dein bestes Creative hatte und warum.

  • Du Lifecycle-Marketing kannst: Klaviyo oder Ähnliches, Flows, Segmente, Churn.

  • Du Zahlen magst: CAC, LTV, Cohorts, Payback und mit unserem Finance-Mitgründer eine Sprache sprichst.

  • Du selbst Ads schaltest, Texte schreibst, Videos schneidest, Decks baust und nicht nur delegierst.

  • Du den DACH-Markt kennst und verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse mitbringst.

  • Du KI-Tools für Content täglich nutzt und weißt, wo ihre Grenze ist.

  • Du Kinder, Eltern und Bildung spannend findest. Nicht nur als Zielgruppe.

  • Du Verantwortung willst, bevor alles fertig ist.

Eher nicht, wenn: du zuletzt vor allem Budgets und Agenturen gesteuert hast und nicht mehr selbst Hand anlegen willst. Oder wenn du nur Performance kannst, aber keine Marke. Oder nur Marke, aber keine Zahlen.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenAPI
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration.

Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs.

You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs.

  • Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration.

  • Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes.

  • Owning features from discovery and design through frontend, backend, deployment and iteration, working closely with the team and learning from users.

There is scope to grow into technical and team leadership over time, depending on your experience and impact.

Requirements

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, with particular strength in frontend development and confidence building backend services and APIs.

  • Strong product judgement and attention to UX, with evidence of making complex workflows intuitive for developers.

  • Experience using user feedback, product data and experimentation to prioritise work and improve measurable outcomes.

  • Independent, end-to-end ownership, clear communication and genuine enthusiasm for developer tools and developer experience.

  • Experience managing or mentoring a small team of software engineers

Prior generative audio experience is not required. Experience building developer-facing products, API dashboards or onboarding flows is particularly valuable. Previous technical or team leadership experience is a plus.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

🚀 Our Story

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly.

🖍️ This role

This is a product-builder role, not a ticket-taking one. You own a product surface end to end: you talk to the customer, form the idea, build it, ship it, measure it, and decide what happens next. The same person who understands the repairer writes the code. There is no handoff for product quality to leak through.

You'll build at the center of a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still runs on phone calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Replacement parts is one of the largest physical markets on earth and one of the least digitised, and there is no established playbook to copy. Partly is creating the category.

Our moat is Interpreter, a domain-specific AI model that understands parts, vehicles, and the messy real-world relationships between them in ways general-purpose models cannot. It is what lets software finally make sense of a physical, offline industry, and it is the engine underneath everything you build.

And what you build is changing shape. We are not bolting AI onto old screens. We are creating genuinely new agentic experiences for a broad spectrum of users, from estimators and parts managers to accountants and suppliers, where people express intent and supervise outcomes while agents handle the mechanical work. Designing how that trust is earned, surface by surface, while each one still delivers value today, is the heart of the role.

You'll work at an inflection point in how software itself gets built. AI-assisted development has collapsed the distance between an idea and a working version of it. The builders we want already work this way: they prototype in an afternoon, put it in front of real customers within days, and read the signal themselves. We want someone who works like that now, or is visibly building toward it.

💻 What will you do

  • Build, not just specify. Prototype new product iterations yourself using AI-assisted and LLM-assisted tooling, fast, disposable, real. Treat the prototype as the hypothesis and put it in front of real customers before writing the spec. Ship production code, instrument it, and watch how it actually gets used.

  • Stay close to customers. Spend time where the work happens. Understand what estimators, parts managers, and others actually do, where they lose time, and what better would feel like. This is a core weekly activity, not an occasional input.

  • Reconcile signal. Combine what you see with what the data says, and reconcile the two when they disagree. Turn that understanding straight into what you build next.

  • Own the outcome. Steer by your surface's metrics; adoption and value delivered are yours. Make the call on priority and explain the reasoning, especially when the answer is no. When something is broken, own it, diagnose it precisely, and fix it.

  • Make the trade-off. Weigh product impact against engineering effort in the same breath, and find the cheaper path to the same outcome.

  • Build the agentic experience. Move your surface from manual operation toward supervised delegation: capture intent, decide where the human stays in the loop, and earn trust step by step so users never lose the thread of a high-stakes job.

  • Hold the craft. The surface feels fast, clear, and considered. You push back when something does not feel right, even when it technically works.

  • Raise the bar. Pair with SW Engineers on the harder systems work behind your surface, and contribute beyond your boundary: shared components, product craft, and what excellent building looks like here as the team grows.

🥷 Your skills

Non-negotiables

  • You ship end to end: a track record of taking features from idea to production, code included, with clear accountability for whether they worked. Roughly 3+ years building and shipping software in production.

  • Genuine customer obsession: a real habit of spending time with users in their work context, with a track record of that depth driving what you build.

  • Product taste and craft: the bar is experiences that feel effortless to time-pressured, non-technical users across fragmented, high-stakes workflows. Functional is not the finish line.

  • A point of view on agentic product design: how an experience moves from manual operation to supervised delegation, and how automation earns user trust gradually rather than all at once.

  • You build rapid prototypes yourself, with AI-assisted tools as a first instinct for testing an idea.

  • Solid full-stack engineering with a frontend lean: production-quality code and sound fundamentals. Systems-specialist depth is not the point of the role.

  • Trade-off fluency: you weigh product impact against engineering effort and often find a cheaper route to the same result.

  • Strong analytical instinct: you define the metric, build the view, read it, and act, without waiting for a data team.

  • You operate well in ambiguity and autonomy, and shape the problem rather than waiting for a spec.

Strong signals we look for

  • Shipped AI-assisted or agent-driven features in production, particularly where the human stays in the loop.

  • Built for a multi-persona, operational, or workflow-heavy B2B product.

  • Founder background, or early employee at a startup that scaled materially.

  • You've killed or radically changed something you personally believed in, and can explain why.

Bonus

  • Marketplace or network experience, from the demand or supply side.

title: Founding Growth Marketer
description:
About SuperchargeMe

SuperchargeMe is one brain for the whole commerce business. Ten products, Ads-IQ, Retention-IQ, Restock-IQ, Stores-IQ, Marketplaces-IQ, Crossborder-IQ, NPD-IQ, Concierge-IQ, Feeds-IQ and Partnership-IQ, share one set of numbers. They don't stop at recommendations: they make the changes too, at the level of control each brand chooses. It works inside Slack, plugs into 100+ tools from Shopify and NetSuite to Meta, Google and Amazon, and is running 23 brands today across paid media, retention, inventory and wholesale, stores, marketplaces, catalog and partnerships.

Every function has a tool. Nothing runs the whole. We built SuperchargeMe to run the whole.

The product is live and brands are paying for it. Getting it in front of the right brands is the next step. That's you.

The role in a sentence

Be our first marketer and own the go-to-market: fill the sales calendar with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CMOs and VPs of E-Commerce at mid-market omnichannel brands, and grow the brands that sign up on their own.

Where we are

SuperchargeMe is already revenue-generating, with brands paying for it every month. What it doesn't have yet is a way for the next hundred brands to find it.

Who we sell to: mid-market omnichannel brands in the US, UK and EU, selling across their own store, marketplaces, wholesale and retail. Two ways in: brands starting with a single product sign up and get going on their own. Brands that want several platforms working together, with onboarding, book a demo.

There's no marketing team, agency or playbook yet. You start with a live website, a sales deck, a product you can demo, and case studies from our first clients that are being written now. A founding Account Executive starts alongside you, so every demo you book has a closer waiting, while sign-ups go straight into the product.

The story is ready to tell. Brands run ten to twenty tools, each now with its own AI, and none of them agree. We call it the Silo Tax. Naming it, and making brand leaders feel it, is the heart of this job.

The work

  • Set the go-to-market plan: which buyers and markets we go after first, and through which channels.
  • Run paid media yourself across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and anything else that works, alongside email, retargeting, campaigns aimed at named brands, events, and joint marketing with agencies, Shopify partners and systems integrators.
  • Work out which of our ten products to lead with for each type of buyer, and write the messaging for each.
  • Build and look after the route to a demo: landing pages, the booking flow, qualifying questions, quick follow-up and a clean handover to sales.
  • Grow self-serve sign-ups, from the first visit to an account that's actually using the product, including our Shopify App Store listing.
  • Turn our case studies and the founders' experience into posts, pages and short videos.
  • Use our own agents on your campaigns, starting with Ads-IQ on Google and Meta.
  • Report every week on demos, sign-ups, activation, pipeline and what each one cost.

What good looks like

We'll measure you on qualified demos and sign-ups, and the revenue they lead to.

Clicks, impressions and ROAS only matter as far as they get us there.

  • After your first month, tracking is set up properly, you've agreed the list of target brands with sales, and your first campaign is running.
  • After your first quarter, demos and sign-ups come in every week from channels you set up, and you know what each one costs by channel.
  • Sales starts asking for more of one kind of lead, because those are the deals that close.
  • The case studies already being written with our first clients are published, and sales uses them in every deal.

What you bring

  • At least four years in B2B demand generation or growth, ideally at a software company selling to e-commerce or retail brands.
  • You've run Meta, Google and LinkedIn campaigns yourself, including campaigns aimed at a list of named companies, without an agency doing it for you.
  • You can show the pipeline or sign-ups you've been responsible for, and what they cost.
  • You write well enough that a CMO reads to the end.
  • You build your own reporting in the CRM and analytics tools.
  • You already use AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work and can show us how. We sell AI agents, so we'd expect that.
  • You're comfortable being the first and only marketer for a while.

Bonus points

  • You've run a DTC or e-commerce brand.
  • You've built demand from zero at an early-stage B2B company.
  • You've run events or executive dinners in commerce or retail.

Skip this one if

  • Your best campaigns needed an agency to run them.
  • You report clicks and impressions and call it pipeline.
  • You'd rather write the plan than ship the campaign.
  • You want a remote or mostly remote role. We're together in North London Monday to Thursday.

Why join

  • You'll set up marketing from scratch, and you'll have a say in who joins the team after you.
  • Most brand leaders haven't yet seen AI that takes actions on their business. You'll shape how they first hear about it.
  • You'll work alongside both founders, who ran commerce brands before building software. Decisions are quick, and what you hear from the market gets into the product fast.
  • You can use our agents on your own work from your first day.

How we hire

  • A 30-minute intro call with the co-founders.
  • A short exercise: a one-page plan for getting qualified demos from mid-market omnichannel brands and growing sign-ups.
  • A working session with the founders on your plan.
  • References.

What you get

£60,000–£75,000 salary plus bonus

Share options so you own a real piece of what you build. Plus a company car and a strong benefits package.

In person in North London, Monday to Thursday, with Fridays flexible

Own Conveo's data, from the warehouse to the dashboard, and build the team every part of the business relies on.

This role can be based from either our London or Antwerp location.

Conveo is building the AI-powered infrastructure for consumer understanding, making consumer and B2B research fast, affordable and high quality. Global brands such as Unilever, Google and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across their marketing, product and research teams.

Backed by Y Combinator, we're in a period of rapid growth. We started this year with around 20 people and are on track to reach around 120 by year end, so the people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how the company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

The Role

You'll be our first Head of Data. You'll own internal data at Conveo and build the team that serves the whole company with it.

You won't be starting from a blank page. Our GTM engineering team has built a data warehouse and semantic layer and has made a start on BI, and colleagues in operations have helped shape our metric definitions. What we don't have is one person who owns all of it, knows what good looks like, and turns it into something every team trusts and uses.

You'll report to our CFO and work very closely with our CTO, as well as with the engineering team, operations and go-to-market. This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the data yourself, not writing a strategy and handing it over. You'll start as the first member of the data team, with a remit to hire as we grow.

This is a role for the long term, not an audit-and-leave project. It starts with the foundations and grows into a bigger team, with room for machine learning and data science to help us predict more across the business.

What You'll Do

Own the data stack end to end

  • Take ownership of our warehouse (Google BigQuery), our transformation and semantic layers (dbt and Cube today) and our BI tooling (Metabase today)

  • Review what's been built with a critical eye, and get it ready to scale as new tools and data sources come in

  • Think through access rights, so it's clear who can see customer, HR and financial data once it all lives in one place

Build one source of truth the business trusts

  • Own metric definitions, so every team works from the same numbers

  • Close the gaps that matter most, starting with areas like marketing attribution and the data our finance team needs for its analysis

  • Make our data reliable enough that people trust it and act on it

Turn data into insight for every team

  • Sit down with department leads, get to the real question behind a request, and build the analysis that answers it

  • Act as the translator between engineering and the business: ask engineers the hard questions about what to build, and explain data in plain English to everyone else

  • Swap today's sprawl of one-off dashboards and AI-generated reports for a clear set of things people actually need to look at

  • After three months: you've reviewed the setup in place and own BigQuery, the transformation layer and our BI tooling, and our systems are ready to scale. Teams are already using data better because of work you've delivered.

  • After six months: every department is running with deep insights and analytics, and our leaders have the confidence and ability to use the data themselves.

  • Throughout: people trust the numbers, the business has the dashboards it needs rather than a thousand it doesn't, and we know who the data team hires next.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience leading data at a startup or scale-up, as a Head of Data, Head of Analytics or similar. Ideally you've been at a Series B company or later and have seen what good structure looks like at the next stage

  • Hands-on BI and analytics experience. You've done the insights work, not only data engineering, and you know what good BI looks like

  • Enough technical depth to ask engineers the hard questions, and a clear understanding of how data flows from the warehouse through transformation and semantic layers into a BI tool.

  • A problem solver's instinct: you can talk to a department lead, draw out what they really need, and turn it into analysis

  • A commercial mindset: you understand how a business works and what it needs from its data

  • Strong stakeholder skills. Lots of people will want your time, and you prioritise well while keeping their trust

  • Everyday use of AI in how you work, and a view on how to build data that AI tools can rely on

  • Experience of the challenges that come with scaling fast, and a clear sense of the structure you'll bring as we grow

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

title: GPU Engineer
description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.


What excites you

  • Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

  • Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

  • Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

  • Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

  • Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

  • Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

  • Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

  • Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

  • Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

  • Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

  • Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

  • Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

  • A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

  • Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

  • Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

  • Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

  • Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

  • Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

  • A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

  • Build lasting relationships with senior decision makers up to C-level

  • Deep understanding of the TV, OTT and streaming market
  • Established network in Eastern and/or Northern European markets
  • Confident negotiating with C-level and procurement teams
  • Business fluent English

Nice to have

  • Language skills in one or more Eastern or Northern European languages
  • Experience selling modular tech or SaaS platforms
  • German language skills are advantageous

  • Ownership: Takes full responsibility for their markets and deals, without relying on a large sales support machine.
  • Honest Forecasting: Reports pipeline and forecast realistically and transparently, including bad news early.
  • Team Player: Works closely with Product, Sales Engineering and Legal and values collaboration over individual heroics.
  • Hands-on Mentality: Comfortable building structures and materials themselves where needed.
  • Long-term Thinking: Builds relationships for the long run instead of chasing quick wins.

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
