title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program.

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems.

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.


Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated.

Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics.

Starting dates: Fall 2026

title: Solution Architect (Prototyping)
Security Engineer (Remote - Germany)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Keep a simple risk register and GRC documentation up to date

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Watch emerging AI threats (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass) and incidents at our AI providers

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 2+ years of hands-on security experience

  • Hands-on AppSec, not compliance only: you review code regularly and can walk us through a real vulnerability you found and fixed

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

  • A hacker mindset: You love breaking things to make them safer, and security isn’t only your job: you do it for fun too, through bug bounties, CTFs, research, write-ups or your own tools.


Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • Experience at an AI company or a scale-up

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Product Qualification Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will execute product qualification activities, turning qualification plans into robust test setups, reliable bench data, and clear, traceable evidence that supports product release.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Reliability Engineer, Product Engineering team, and external laboratories and OSAT partners to plan and execute qualification testing. You will develop test hardware in collaboration with external partners, coordinate the design of test PCBs and fixtures, select and configure test equipment, and ensure every qualification campaign produces accurate, well-documented, and reproducible results.

Your core focus will be to transform qualification requirements into practical test solutions, execute high-quality validation campaigns, and deliver the reliable data needed to make confident product qualification and release decisions.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Run product qualification testing by performing bench and laboratory qualification tests (thermal, electrical, mechanical, and environmental stress tests) in accordance with qualification plans and test matrix, while accurately tracking samples, test conditions, and results.

  • Develop test PCBs and fixtures with external partners, work on test boards, adapters, and fixtures, from requirements through review and bring-up.

  • Set up and maintain qualification test equipment, including thermal chambers, power supplies, data acquisition systems (DAQ), probe stations, and other laboratory instrumentation, ensuring the lab is always ready to support qualification activities.

  • Coordinate qualification campaigns with OSATs and external laboratories by managing schedules, sample logistics, and test execution, while providing on-site or remote test supervision where needed

  • Collect, analyze, and document qualification results, producing clear pass/fail assessments, comprehensive test reports, and fully traceable records that contribute to the overall product qualification evidence package.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, proactively escalating test failures, equipment limitations, data anomalies, or schedule risks to the Package Reliability Engineer and Quality & Reliability Program Lead to keep qualification activities on track.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on product qualification experience with 2–4+ years of experience in hardware bring-up, bench testing, or product qualification test campaigns.

  • Experience testing RF and high-speed I/O, including high-speed serial, RF, or optical links using equipment such as vector network analyzers (VNAs), high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, BERTs, and other signal integrity measurement tools. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

Responsibilities

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

The bar is concrete. At least one to two good pieces of content go out every day. The audience grows, and it is the right audience: finance and operations leaders, founders and the people around them. Inbound interest arrives that can be traced back to something you published. You will have the founder’s time, the customers’ stories and the product’s progress as raw material; turning that into a consistent, credible voice is your job.

  • External communication. Press relations, podcasts, events and speaking, launches and announcements, partner communication; working with PR agencies where engaged.

  • The network. Journalists, podcasters, communities and ecosystem contacts, kept on a live list and in a warm relationship.

  • Brand assets. Guidelines, templates and tone of voice, kept current and actually used.

For example, a customer goes live and their CFO says something memorable in the final call. You would turn it into a founder post the same day, a short video for the company channel the next, a line in the newsletter and a pitch to a journalist who covers finance software, and track what came back from each.

What you bring

You have three or more years in content, social media or communications for a B2B company or a founder brand, with proof of an audience you built and content you shipped at pace. You write clearly in German and English, edit short video and work with design tools and AI tools every day.

You understand finance, software or the Mittelstand well enough to write for a demanding audience without embarrassing yourself or us. Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. **This position is based in Germany with remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Senior Accountant owns the end-to-end accounting for Chaos’s German entity, which is the main distributor of Chaos products worldwide. The role ensures full statutory compliance and timely financial reporting, and works closely with finance colleagues across the global business, combining technical accounting rigour with a process-improvement mindset so the business can move fast and operate at scale. This role requires an accountant with strong German GAAP and tax knowledge and experience in an international group.


Main Responsibilities

  • Own the full accounting cycle for Chaos Software GmbH, including general ledger, fixed assets, payroll postings, reconciliations, and monthly, quarterly and annual close, in line with German GAAP and group reporting requirements.

  • Act as the primary contact for external auditors, tax advisors and statutory filings.

  • Manage local treasury activity and payment cycles in coordination with the group finance team.

  • Prepare and submit all VAT returns and filings.

  • Define and maintain global standards for AP processes with teams across Chaos’s international entities, harmonising workflows, closing process gaps and driving automation in NetSuite and connected finance tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate workflows, supporting the Accounting Director in building a culture of continuous improvement across finance.

  • Support accounting activities across the wider international group, including ad hoc projects as required.


  • 5 years of experience in financial accounting within an international corporate environment, ideally in a technology, software or SaaS business.

  • Experience working within an international group structure.

  • Experience with German statutory requirements and German GAAP (HGB), including preparing annual financial statements, balance sheet reconciliations and note disclosures.

  • Good understanding of German tax law, including corporate tax, trade tax, VAT declarations and withholding taxes.

  • Experience driving process improvement projects across finance.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP, and familiarity with finance tooling in a software product environment.

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting or a comparable field.

  • Experience with IFRS is an advantage.

  • Experience with intercompany transactions and transfer pricing is an advantage.

  • A professional qualification (e.g. ACCA, CIMA) is an advantage and is not required where offset by strong practical experience.

Required Skills

  • Applies mastery of German accounting principles to prepare accurate, compliant statutory financial statements.

  • Works confidently across multicultural, multi-timezone teams.

  • Steps back from operational tasks to spot inefficiencies and builds scalable solutions that work across the group.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken, are required. Additional languages are an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
description:
Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.

We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.

We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.

  • Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.

  • Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.

  • Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.

  • Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.

  • Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.

  • Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code.

  • A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

  • The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.

  • Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.

  • Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment.

  • Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems.

  • A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration.

  • Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents.

  • Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware).

  • Familiarity with ROS 2 or simulation frameworks.

  • Knowledge of communication protocols and low-latency data transport.

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
description:
“This is not your typical B2G role.”

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at.

Why this role exists

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers.

What you'll own

  • Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved.

  • Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes.

  • Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities.

  • Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector.

  • Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects.

  • Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

  • Create visibility. References with municipalities and mayors that show publicly what's happening in their region.

  • Leadership. Over time, build a small B2G team, including working students.

You're a fit if you

  • Have several years of experience in the public sector, politics, municipal utilities, economic development agencies, associations or funding management.

  • Have successfully won funding (EU, federal, state) or led consortia.

  • Know how municipalities make decisions and buy, and have a strong network in NRW or beyond.

  • Understand energy transition topics such as municipal heat planning, grid congestion and flexibility.

  • Think like an entrepreneur and see public funding as a path to a business case.

  • Are curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Speak business-fluent German and bring good English for EU programmes.

What we offer

  • A business line you build from scratch, with a direct line to the management team.

  • Real financial leverage: what you win shows up directly in RIZM's cash flow.

  • A product already running at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Salary plus equity.

How to apply

No cover letter needed. We'd rather hear how you think. Two questions, a few honest sentences each:

  • A mayor gives you 5 minutes in an elevator. What do you tell them about RIZM?

  • What's the most absurd hurdle you've hit in public funding or procurement, and how did you get around it?

You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. description:

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

  • Coordonner le programme de contrôle périodique et suivre sa mise en œuvre conformément au plan d’audit défini.

  • Garantir la robustesse et la bonne exécution du dispositif PSEE.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment.

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective.

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery.

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership, for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager.

This role will suit you if…

title: Head of Infrastructure
description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

description:

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems to join the Core team within our Platform Team. Everything we build is a node: from small embedded devices to full compute systems and ground infrastructure. Together they operate as one network, in the field and over denied, degraded and intermittent links. You design how this works end to end: how nodes find and connect to each other, how trust propagates, how they communicate, and how every node exposes what the application stack needs. And you build it: the network itself, the node agent that runs on every node, the node API and the SDK.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • System design: Own the end-to-end design of how our systems connect and communicate: topology, links, transports, delivery semantics and failure behaviour. When a new requirement lands, such as operating a system beyond line of sight over LEO satellite or cellular links, you design how it works: latency budget, link selection and failover, security, and what keeps working when the link drops

  • The network: Build it: addressing plans, routing, segmentation and multi-homing across tactical radio, cellular, satcom and wired links, with dynamic routing and link selection for nodes that move and links that fail

  • Secure links: IPsec/IKEv2 or WireGuard overlays with certificate authentication from hardware-backed keys, including rekeying, NAT traversal and behaviour on link loss

  • Trust: Design how trust propagates from production to the field: device identity, certificate lifecycle, mutual authentication, authorisation tiers, revocation and signed commands that keep working without backend connectivity

  • Node agent: Design and build the agent that runs on every node and exposes identity, health, software state, connectivity and updates through one API, served locally, over the network and in compact form over constrained links. Devices too small to run it are represented through their parent node

  • Node API and SDK: One resource model for every node type, versioned and backward compatible across a fleet that never updates all at once, with SDKs generated from the contract for the languages our teams use

  • Discovery and directory: How nodes find each other with and without infrastructure, and a directory that survives restarts and shows what should exist versus what is present, at fleet scale without polling every node

  • Communication: Build on proven middleware and transports instead of reinventing them, define delivery semantics per traffic class, and engineer QoS so command and control traffic survives congestion on constrained links

  • Network as code: Configuration templated, version controlled, validated in CI and shipped as part of the system release

  • Verification: Network emulation that reproduces measured field link profiles, fault injection in CI, and network test campaigns at test ranges and flight tests with root cause from packet captures

  • Direction: Write the design documents and contracts that embedded, backend and application engineers build against, and review designs


  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years building networked or distributed systems in production, combining software engineering with hands-on network engineering, including technical ownership of a core component other teams depend on

  • Designed a networked system end to end, and can reason through a new connectivity scenario from first principles: topology, latency budget, failure modes and security

  • Expert in Rust, Go or C++, working proficiency in Python, and comfortable reading and writing C++

  • Strong networking across the stack: IP addressing and routing, UDP, TCP and QUIC internals, congestion control, multicast, NAT traversal, MTU and fragmentation; fluent with Wireshark and tcpdump

  • Expert Linux networking: iproute2, policy routing, network namespaces, VRFs, bridges, VLANs, nftables, tc and netem

  • Production experience with IPsec (strongSwan or libreswan) and WireGuard, including PKI-based authentication

  • Routing: OSPF and BGP (ideally FRRouting or BIRD), and how latency, loss and link quality shape routing and protocol design in dynamic networks

  • Applied security: PKI and certificate lifecycle, mTLS, hardware-backed keys (TPM or secure elements) and authorisation models

  • Built services that run on devices: Linux daemons, systemd, local IPC and resource-constrained environments

  • Experience with middleware such as DDS, ROS 2, Zenoh, ZeroMQ, NATS or gRPC, including discovery, flow control, serialisation and QoS

  • API and contract design consumed by many teams: schema evolution, versioning and backward compatibility

  • Written design documents that other teams implemented against

  • Willingness to travel to test sites and flight tests (around 20%)

Nice to haves

  • Systems built for denied, degraded, intermittent or limited (DDIL) connectivity: defense, robotic fleets, autonomous vehicles, space

  • Beyond-line-of-sight operation over LEO satellite, cellular or long-range radio links

  • Integration of MANET or mesh radios (e.g. Silvus, Doodle Labs, Persistent Systems) and MANET routing such as OLSR or B.A.T.M.A.N.

  • Network emulation with EMANE, CORE, ns-3 or Linux netem

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!'', dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams!

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions.

  • Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions.

  • Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solve the hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements.

  • Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
description:

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

title: Senior Lead Claims Operations (m/f/x)
description:
Who We Are

At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide.

By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys.

With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Claims Operations to lead our small claims team, strengthen our global claims operations, and drive the development of the tools that support our members and team.

Our members come to us during one of the hardest phases of their lives. A fertility journey is physically and emotionally exhausting, and a slow reimbursement or an unclear answer adds stress nobody should have to carry. That is why member experience sits at the heart of every claims process we run: we respond fast, we explain decisions clearly, and we treat every piece of member feedback as important. We want our members to feel the difference to a traditional insurer at every step.

This is a player-coach role combining team leadership, operational oversight, and product improvement. You’ll guide and develop the team, manage quality and workload, and continuously improve our processes. You’ll also stay close to daily operations by handling complex or escalated cases, reviewing selected claims, and stepping in during periods of increased demand. Your routine caseload will be significantly smaller than that of a Claims Processor, allowing you to focus where your experience and judgement have the greatest impact.

Working closely with the VP Member Experience, Legal, Clinical Operations, and Finance, you’ll help maintain a fair, consistent, and compliant claims framework across our markets. You’ll bring practical judgement to reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation, recognising country-specific requirements and knowing when specialist input is needed.

You’ll also drive the continuous development of our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet in partnership with Product and Engineering. You’ll translate operational and member needs into clear requirements, help prioritise improvements, and ensure new features meet those requirements before launch.

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic leader who combines strong analytical skills with precision and attention to detail. You’ll enjoy being close to the work, use data to guide decisions, take ownership of improvements, and understand the impact every claim can have on a member’s journey.

What you will do

Team leadership and daily operations

  • Lead and develop our claims team through coaching, feedback, and regular quality reviews.

  • Coordinate workloads, priorities, and coverage to meet service levels and maintain a sustainable workload.

  • Handle complex or escalated cases, review selected claims, and support processing during periods of increased demand.

  • Define clear targets and SLAs for the team, such as turnaround times, processing accuracy, and member satisfaction. Track them continuously, report on progress to the VP Member Experience, and drive measurable improvements quarter over quarter.

Process improvement and member experience

  • Use operational data and team insights to identify recurring issues and improve workflows across markets and product lines.

  • Maintain consistent claims decisions, clear documentation, and effective escalation and quality-assurance processes.

  • Ensure members receive accurate, timely, and empathetic communication throughout the claims journey.

Claims products, wallet, automation and AI

  • Drive improvements to our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet with Product and Engineering, and identify where AI can make claims work faster and more accurate.

  • Define product requirements and acceptance criteria, including where AI may support a decision and where human review remains mandatory, and help prioritise enhancements based on member needs, operational impact, data protection, and risk.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, validate features before launch, and prepare the team through updated workflows and training.

  • Monitor results after launch, including the quality and accuracy of AI outputs, and drive further improvements.

Claims framework, regulatory requirements, and controls

  • Review provider contracts, invoices, and claims documentation for market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, involving Legal, Clinical Operations, or Finance where needed.

  • Maintain the claims framework and translate agreed requirements into practical workflows, controls, and guidance.

  • Partner with Finance on payment accuracy and reconciliation, support audits, and address control or compliance gaps.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in claims, healthcare benefits, reimbursement, insurance operations, or a related field, including three years coordinating or leading a team.

  • Hands-on expertise in complex claims, quality assurance, operational controls, and financial reconciliation.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, ideally in operational workflows such as document processing or case handling, with a clear sense of where human judgement and data protection require oversight.

  • Experience reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation against market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, recognising when specialist input is needed.

  • Experience defining product requirements with Product and Engineering, testing new features, and supporting operational rollouts.

  • Experience improving processes and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, ideally within a technology company or scale-up.

  • Strong analytical skills, precision, and attention to detail, using operational KPIs to guide decisions and improvements.

  • Clear communication, sound judgement, and a collaborative, empathetic leadership style focused on the member experience.

  • Professional fluency in English.

title: Trading Manager
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

  • Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

  • Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

  • Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

  • Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

  • Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

  • You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

  • You act fast. You decide and follow up.

  • You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation.

  • You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls.

Background

  • You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works.

  • Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a university degree.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality: you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade.

  • German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently.

  • English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language.

What’s In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis

  • Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join

You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI.
Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  • Own the full solution end to end, whatever form it takes — physical automation, software/control changes, or a combination of both

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.

Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days.
