SC Clearance Requirements:

Due to working with several government bodies, SC clearance is required for all our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. In future, DV clearance may be required, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

You must be UK-based.

About us

We help major public and private sector organisations scale cloud and AI with speed, control and clarity. Hard-won experience sits behind a values-led business that does the right thing, puts customers first and builds partnerships on trust rather than lock-in.

Our work is practical. We design secure, production-ready foundations that hold up in the real world and deliver lasting value, without the waste that slows most transformations down. And we don't advise from the sidelines. We build, fix and deliver ourselves, with no offshoring, no resource-padding and no compromises.

What you'll do

Cloudscaler works closely with three of the companies shaping cloud and AI right now: AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI. Those partnerships open real doors for us and our customers. Funding for customer programmes. Early access to new models and services. Joint go-to-market. But they only pay off when someone runs them properly. That's this role.

You'll own the operational side of our partner programmes. Your goals are clear: help us win partner funding for our customers, achieve new AWS competencies and programme designations, and keep our partner CRMs in excellent shape. The partner managers at AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI will know you by name.

This isn't a back-office admin job. AI partner programmes change quarter to quarter, and we want someone who'll build smarter ways of running them. If you've ever automated a tedious task because you couldn't face doing it by hand a second time, you'll fit right in.

External responsibilities

These responsibilities are partner-facing and customer-facing:

Competencies and programme designations - Driving our AWS competency and programme applications, and tracking tier requirements, certifications and renewals across AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI so that nothing lapses.

Partner funding applications - Preparing, submitting and tracking partner funding applications (for example the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and proof-of-concept funding), working with our sales and delivery teams to gather what each one needs.

Funding claims - Managing funding claims through to payment, keeping milestones, evidence and deadlines in order.

Partner relationships - Acting as the main operational contact for our partner teams, building strong working relationships with each company.

Joint campaigns and events - Helping plan and run joint marketing campaigns with our partners, and representing Cloudscaler at partner events across the UK.

Internal responsibilities

These responsibilities cover the systems, reporting and ways of working behind our partner programmes.

Partner CRMs - Owning our partner CRMs, keeping deal registrations, opportunity data and partner portals accurate across HubSpot and AWS Partner Central.

Reporting - Reporting on partner performance, funding pipeline and programme health to the leadership team.

Automation - Finding the repetitive work and automating it, using AI tools such as Claude to build workflows, trackers and agents that give the team time back.

Briefing colleagues - Briefing colleagues when programmes change, and explaining what it means for our customers and bids.

What we're looking for

This is an operational role with plenty of partner contact. We expect candidates to demonstrate the following:

Operational experience - Experience in partner operations, alliance management, programme management or a similar operational role, ideally in tech or professional services.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

description:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz.

Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.


ÜBER DEINEN JOB
  • Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten.
  • Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst.
  • Da Du von Herzen Engineer bist, schreibst Du Code, um manuelle Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du weißt sowieso, dass es der einzige Weg ist.
  • Du bist aber auch für unser ISMS (Information Security Management System) verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass dieses stets auf dem neuesten Stand ist und die Regeln und Vorschriften im ISMS sinnvoll und hilfreich sind. Ebenso arbeitest Du mit unserem Datenschutzbeauftragten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die DSGVO einhalten.
  • Du stärkst unsere Mitglieder auch, indem Du ihnen Sicherheit beibringst. Sowohl durch die Gestaltung von Schulungen als auch durch die Unterstützung bei der Schaffung einer sicheren Infrastruktur in ihren Projekten.
  • Das Jobprofil ist eine tolle Chance für Software Engineers, die ihr Spektrum in Richtung Sicherheit und Compliance erweitern und zudem strategisch arbeiten möchten.
  • Wir glauben auch, dass eine kleine Dosis Zwangsstörung hilfreich sein könnte ;-). Zumindest solltest Du den starken Willen haben, die Dinge richtig zu machen, und sehr sorgfältig bei Deiner Arbeit sein.

    • ÜBER DICH
    Qualifikationen:
  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik
  • Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes
  • Erfahrung in der UNIX-Systemadministration und Networking
  • Programmiererfahrung – idealerweise in Go
  • Hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner vergangenen Projekte
  • Die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. 
    • Bonus Skills and Interessen:
  • Master oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik oder Physik
  • Erfahrung in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) oder Microsoft Azure
  • Erfahrung mit Observability (Protokollierung, Überwachung, Alarmierung, Rückverfolgung)
  • Erfahrung mit Security
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit verteilten Systemen in der Cloud (Terraform)
  • Erfahrung im Einrichten von CI/CD-Pipelines

    • ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY

    Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“.

    Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. 

    In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. 

    Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end.

    Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst.

title: Expert Solution Architect, AI & Enterprise (all genders)
description:
About the Role

You'll own the path from a corporate client's business problem to a target architecture the CIO signs and the CFO funds. Not one platform, the whole picture: CRM, data, integrations, custom software, and the agentic AI layer on top. You'll lead discovery with enterprise clients, structure what they actually need, design the solution, defend it in the steering committee, and hand delivery a scope that holds. This is an Expert seat: the architecture benchmark of our Consulting Practice, no people management.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discovery and solution design on our enterprise engagements, turning ambiguous business problems into signed target architectures across CRM, data, custom software, and agentic AI

  • Own the architecture through delivery, so what you design in pre-sales is what gets built, without structural redesigns after signature

  • Scope six-figure engagements with estimates that hold, phasing that corporate procurement can sign, and risks named up front

  • Build the team's Solution Design Toolkit: discovery framework, architecture decision template, and an honest agentic-fit assessment that says where agents add value and where they don't

  • Present and defend architectures in front of CIOs, CFOs, and business unit heads, in German and English

  • Create reusable solution patterns (master data ownership between CRM and ERP, agent orchestration on HubSpot, data remediation before AI) that consultants and engineers actually use

  • Partner with our AI & Engineering Practice as the architecture counterpart: you own the solution design, they own the technical blueprint and the build

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 6+ years in consulting or solution architecture, with at least 2 years personally owning solution design for enterprise clients on the advisory or vendor side, from discovery to signature

  • A track record of structuring ambiguous business problems into architecture options, scope, and risk, with artefacts you produced yourself and can walk us through

  • Architecture-level fluency across at least one enterprise CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Dynamics), one ERP (SAP or Dynamics), data platforms (warehouse, CDP, or MDM), and integration patterns (event-driven, API, iPaaS or middleware)

  • At least one AI or agentic solution you designed or delivered that ran in production for a client, with business outcomes you can name and failures you can explain

  • Experience leading conversations with CIO, CFO, procurement, IT security, and business stakeholders inside corporate groups, including telling an executive no with a case behind it

  • Commercial judgment on scoping and estimating engagements, and ownership when estimates miss

  • German and English at full business fluency, with the ability to present the same architecture to a CFO and to a delivery team

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on HubSpot enterprise experience or HubSpot Solutions Architect certification (we fund it if you don't have it)

  • Direct experience with EU AI Act and DSGVO as design constraints in regulated industries (manufacturing, financial services, healthcare)

  • A background in one of our core client sectors: industrial manufacturing, building products, or B2B distribution

  • Talks, articles, or teaching on enterprise architecture or applied AI

Your Team

You'll join the Strategy Consulting team within Thorit's Consulting Practice, which owns the strategy layer of our engagements. The Team Lead Strategy Consulting seat is currently open, so you'll report directly to the Practice Lead Consulting until it is filled. Day to day you'll work with our CRM Implementation and Managed Services teams, the Project Management Practice, and the AI & Engineering Practice in Böblingen and Lisbon, which builds what you design. Our company language is English.

Tech Stack

  • Core: HubSpot (CRM, Marketing, Sales, Service, Operations Hub), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude AI

  • Architecture & design: architecture decision records, C4 and sequence diagrams, Miro

  • Enterprise landscape you design against: SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery), CDP and MDM concepts, iPaaS and custom middleware

  • AI & agents: LLM-based agents on Claude and other models, retrieval, orchestration frameworks, evaluation and guardrails; the engineering team builds with Claude Code and Cursor

What We Offer

  • 31 days of paid vacation: 30 days plus one additional company day each year, well above the German statutory minimum of 20

  • Company pension (Allianz): employer contribution from your second year, rising with tenure from €50 to €290 per month

  • Lunch allowance: €5 tax-free per working day via Lunchit, up to €100 per month, usable anywhere

  • Business Bike: bicycle leasing through payroll with full insurance and free brand choice

  • Corporate Benefits: discounts across several hundred brands for private use

  • Hybrid Flex model: two office days per week at our Böblingen HQ, the rest where you work best

  • Real ownership: direct client leadership on enterprise engagements, and a Practice that builds and operates agentic systems rather than presenting them

About Thorit

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software agents that act on goals instead of waiting for clicks; for an enterprise, that translates into less manual work and more margin. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients across the DACH market, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but a concrete example of an enterprise engagement where you personally took a client's business problem through discovery to a signed target architecture, including what you scoped, what you told the client not to build, and how far delivery deviated from your design, is required.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

title: Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.


Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
  • A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
  • A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
  • Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
  • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

The Mission 🪐
  • The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

    • Key Responsibilities ✨

    Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
  • Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
  • Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

    • Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command

  • Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
  • Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
  • Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

    • Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

  • Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
  • Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

  • A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
  • Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
  • Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
  • Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
  • C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
  • Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.

    • The Self-Selection Filter ❓

    This role is perfect for you if:

  • You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
  • You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
  • You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

    • This role is NOT for you if:

  • You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
  • You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
  • You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

    • 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
  • Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
  • Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
  • Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance. Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
  • Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo, to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
  • Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.
  • Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.
    • Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.
    💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.
    🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year.
    📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years.
    📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options. 
    🍽️ Lunch vouchers: 6,50€ per day / 15 days a month.
    🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin!
    ❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App.
    📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Talent Acquisition Intern

Deine Mission bei trawa

Bei trawa sind wir überzeugt: Die Energiewende beginnt bei den Menschen, die sie möglich machen. Du willst leistungsstarke Teams mit aufbauen und Recruiting von Grund auf so lernen, dass es wirklich Wirkung hat? Dann bist du bei trawa genau richtig.

Als Talent Acquisition Intern bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Talent-Teams und sorgst mit uns dafür, dass die richtigen Menschen zu trawa finden. Du hältst unsere Prozesse am Laufen, gestaltest reibungslose Candidate Journeys, räumst administrative Hürden aus dem Weg und hilfst, ein Hiring-Erlebnis zu bauen, das hängen bleibt. So bringst du direkt mit voran, was uns antreibt: Unternehmen den Zugang zu echter, grüner Energie zu ermöglichen.

Diese Rolle passt perfekt zu dir, wenn du Talent Acquisition hands-on lernen willst, gerne mit modernen Tools und KI-Lösungen arbeitest und direkt sehen möchtest, wie dein Beitrag das gesamte Team schneller und besser macht.

Bei uns findest du keine starren Strukturen - dafür Gestaltungsspielraum, Vertrauen und ein Team, das die Energiewende gemeinsam voranbringt.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Was du bei uns vorantreibst

  • Bewerbungen screenen: Bewerbungen entlang klarer Basic Requirements checken und Kandidat:innen schnell und fair durch die Pipeline steuern.

  • ATS & Tracking: Unser ATS sauber, aktuell und strukturiert halten - plus einfache Tracker pflegen, damit alle jederzeit den Status im Blick haben

  • Interview-Organisation: Interviews end-to-end organisieren: Termine finden, Kalender koordinieren und das Team mit allen Infos versorgen.

  • Candidate Communication: Eine starke Candidate Experience sicherstellen - zeitnahe Updates geben, Fragen beantworten und durch den gesamten Prozess begleiten.

  • Interview-Flow: Feedback von Interviews schnell einsammeln, nachhalten und Stakeholder proaktiv erinnern.

  • Active Sourcing: Kandidat:innen vor allem über LinkedIn finden, erste Profileinschätzungen machen und die Ansprache übernehmen - damit aus „spannend“ schnell ein Gespräch wird.

  • Cross-functional Hiring supporten: Hiring über verschiedene Teams hinweg supporten (Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial) und dabei unterschiedliche Anforderungen & Profile verstehen lernen.

  • Team-Rituale & Ad-hoc: An Talent-Team-Routinen teilnehmen, Best Practices aufschnappen und spontan mit anpacken, wenn’s im Hiring gerade drauf ankommt

Wen wir suchen

  • Eingeschriebenes Studium, Gap Year oder Phase zwischen zwei Studienabschnitten

  • Lust darauf, Recruiting operativ stark aufzustellen und Hiring-Prozesse zu verbessern

  • Hands-on-Mentalität sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen verlässlich ins Ziel zu bringen

  • Empathisches, souveränes und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kandidat:innen und Stakeholdern

  • Strukturierte, detailgenaue Arbeitsweise mit gleichzeitigem Blick für das große Ganze

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Timings zu koordinieren

  • Echtes Interesse an Menschen, Talent und Recruiting Operations

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Tools wie Google Calendar oder hohe Lernbereitschaft im Umgang mit neuen Tools

  • Affinität zu digitalen Tools und Automatisierung, um Recruiting smarter und effizienter zu gestalten

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift

  • Standort in Berlin und Lust auf Zusammenarbeit in einem schönen Office im Herzen der Stadt

Warum trawa?

Summary

We're looking for a commercially minded lawyer to work hands-on with GTM, shaping, negotiating and closing customer deals. GTM partnership and deal execution

  • Work directly with Sales and GTM on customer and partner opportunities, from deal shaping through negotiation and signature.

  • Develop negotiation strategies, propose workable alternatives and help resolve customer objections.

  • Explain risk in commercial terms and help teams move deals forward, escalating material decisions to the General Counsel.

  • Act as a legal engineer to help develop and refine our daily use of AI agents across the business.

  • Draft, review and negotiate SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, security terms and procurement documents.

  • Support vendor, technology-provider and strategic partnership agreements.

  • Integrate privacy, data protection, AI regulatory, security and other relevant considerations into commercial deal strategy.

Playbooks and legal operations

  • Turn recurring GTM questions and negotiation patterns into templates, fallback language, playbooks and training.

  • Use Dust and other appropriate tools to make legal work more efficient, while applying sound judgment to confidential and sensitive matters.

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales, France or another relevant jurisdiction, with substantial commercial contracts experience. Around five years' post-qualification experience is a useful guide, not a hard cutoff and we would consider exceptional candidates with fewer years experience. We hire for talent and aptitude rather than pure qualifications.

  • Experience actively supporting commercial teams and negotiating B2B technology or SaaS deals.

  • Business-standard English is required, including for drafting and negotiation. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential, particularly for the Paris-based position.

Attitude

  • Pragmatic and commercially minded, with the judgment to balance deal momentum and risk. Someone who doesn't just advise, but leads and drives commercial considerations.

  • Clear communicator who can explain legal issues in business terms and work effectively with non-lawyers.

  • Collaborative and confident working across teams in a fast-moving environment.

Agency

  • Takes ownership of commercial legal work through negotiation and signature, rather than providing advice from a distance.

  • Proactively surfaces issues, proposes solutions and escalates material risk decisions appropriately.

  • Looks for ways to make repeatable legal work faster and more consistent.

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

· All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.

o Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

 

Strengthen access and identity controls

o Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.

o Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.

o Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

 

Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

o Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.

o Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

 

Team collaboration

o Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.

Self development

o Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.

· A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals.

· Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.

· Google Cloud: Associate Cloud Engineer.

The interview process

· Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.

· Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.

· Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.

· Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

We are looking for multiple Software Engineer Interns to join some of Back Market’s Engineering teams in the Paris office. Depending on your interests and experience, you may contribute to projects across our product, platform, data, payments, shipping, customer experience or circularity teams.

Our Engineering teams build the technology that powers Back Market, from customer-facing experiences to the internal services used by our teams and partners. You will work alongside software engineers, product managers, designers, data analysts and other stakeholders in a collaborative and international environment.

With support from experienced engineers, you will learn how we design, develop, test, deploy and monitor reliable software in a production environment.

What you will do in this role

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will learn and contribute alongside experienced engineers:

  • Assist with developing and improving features, with guidance from your team.

  • Participate in writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions to learn from the team.

  • Help investigate bugs and support the resolution of technical issues.

  • Participate in testing, deployment and monitoring activities.

  • Work with product, design, data and operations teams to understand requirements.

  • Assist with maintaining technical documentation and sharing knowledge.

  • Explore different technologies and gradually build your skills across the software development lifecycle.

The technologies you use will depend on the team you join. Our engineering environment may include:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Golang and Django

  • Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript, Nuxt and Revolve, our design system

  • Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ and BigQuery

  • Mandatory! Currently enrolled in your final year of an Engineering School/University Master's degree and your university can provide an internship agreement - already based in France

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…

L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.

Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.

  • Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.

  • Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.

  • Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit et métier.

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle à des situations complexes ou urgentes.

  • L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions multilingues à venir selon nos développements à l’étranger.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Un première entretien avec notre Simon, Senior Recruiter (30 min)

  • Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec Nathan, Senior Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Une étude de cas à préparer en amont avec Nathan et Vincent, Associate Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Un échange avec une partie de l'équipe de Specialists Support FST (30 min)

  • Un entretien final avec Johan, Head Of Customer Support (45 min)

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec Nathan, Senior Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Un entretien final avec Johan, Head Of Customer Support (45 min)

title: Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services (Télétravail depuis Marseille)
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1,000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…

L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.

Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.

  • Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.

  • Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.

  • Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit et métier.

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle à des situations complexes ou urgentes.

  • L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions multilingues à venir selon nos développements à l’étranger.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Un première entretien avec notre Simon, Senior Recruiter (30 min)

  • Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec Nathan, Senior Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Une étude de cas à préparer en amont avec Nathan et Vincent, Associate Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Un échange avec une partie de l'équipe de Specialists Support FST (30 min)

  • Un entretien final avec Johan, Head Of Customer Support (45 min)

 
 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

  • Detect vulnerability and propose associated patches

  • Raise the security level of our CI/CD configuration

  • With the DevOps team, secure our AWS infrastructure, including its Kubernetes environment (AWS EKS)

Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct and perform regular security assessments (internally or by an external consulting companies) on the applications (code reviews/pentests/bug bounty in particular) and the infrastructure

  • Be involved in all security incidents, investigate logs, block attacks, and propose corrective measures to prevent future threats.

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?
