title: Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months  experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role 
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment 
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Customer Care Analyst & Ops - CDI
description:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l'infrastructure financière du monde de demain.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l'ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Une reconnaissance qui nous place au niveau des acteurs réglementés de premier plan, et qui change en profondeur ce que nous construisons, et comment.

Green-Got propose :

  • Un compte de paiement associé à une carte pour payer et être payé au quotidien.
  • Une gamme de placements financiers performants pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

L'expérience membre est au cœur de ce modèle. C'est le socle sur lequel repose la confiance que nos membres nous accordent, et que l'équipe Customer Care entretient chaque jour.

Green-Got en chiffres :

  • 100 M€ de transactions traitées chaque mois ;
  • 2,3 Md€ de transactions sécurisées depuis notre lancement ;
  • 2 M€ de dons reversés à des projets de transition ;
  • 4,8/5 sur Trustpilot ;
  • 5 % de notre chiffre d'affaires pour soutenir directement des projets de terrain, en finançant directement la Fondation Green-Got.

Le contexte :

📍 Locaux à Paris + télétravail, ouvert au full remote depuis ton pays de résidence ;
📄 CDI : contrat de 39h /semaine ;
💶 28–32K € selon profil ;
🗓 Prise de poste : au plus tôt.

Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7.

Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre.

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket.

Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois.

Vos missions

Tes missions :

Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got.

Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement.

FRONT - Relation membre 50 %

  • Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais.
  • Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation.
  • Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact.

RUN - Support opérationnel 35 %

  • Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing.
  • Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit.
  • Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution.
  • Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production.

BUILD - Gestion de projet 15 %

  • Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes.
  • Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat.

Vos compétences

L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.

  • Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.
  • Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature.
  • Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes.
  • Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité.
  • Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage.
  • Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité.
  • Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client.
  • Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus.

Avantages

Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.

  • Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour.
  • De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit.
  • Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan.
  • Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés.
  • Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe.
  • Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble.

Le package :

  • CDI remote ou Paris.
  • Rémunération : 28 - 32k, selon profil.
  • BSPCE.
  • Mutuelle santé Alan.
  • Une journée d’équipe tous les semestres.

Déroulement des entretiens :

  • Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation.
  • Call rapide pour faire connaissance. Si ça matche, on t’envoie un Business Case à préparer.
  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent (Customer Care Manager) pour analyser le Business Case et te tester / te connaitre.
  • Échange avec un ou plusieurs membres de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.
  • Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations).
  • Entretien avec Andréa (CEO).

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not.   • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.

title: Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact
description:
L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€).

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs.

Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement.

Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape.

Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème :

  • L’équipe de gestion

  • Les équipes middle office et conformité

  • Nos investisseurs (LPs)

  • Les entreprises de notre portefeuille

Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin.

Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement.

Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre.


Ce que vous construirez concrètement

Pendant votre stage, vous contribuerez à :

  • Structurer et faire évoluer plusieurs années de données d’investissement, impact et ESG

  • Participer à la migration de notre socle de données vers une architecture moderne et évolutive

  • Déployer des automatisations permettant de réduire les tâches manuelles et d’améliorer la qualité des données

  • Concevoir les premiers assistants IA internes de la société

  • Créer des outils utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes d’investissement, le middle office et la conformité

  • Participer à la création de portails dédiés aux investisseurs et aux entreprises du portefeuille

  • Contribuer à définir notre feuille de route data & IA pour les années à venir


Vos missions

Les projets seront menés en lien direct avec les équipes d'investissement, d’impact, le middle office et la conformité. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement très transversal, avec une forte autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer aussi bien à la réflexion qu'à l'implémentation des solutions. 

Les missions décrites ci-dessous constituent une feuille de route initiale. Elles évolueront naturellement en fonction de l’avancement du projet, de vos centres d’intérêt et des opportunités identifiées ensemble.

  1. Comprendre et structurer notre écosystème de données

Vous participerez notamment à :

  • Cartographier les bases Airtable existantes et leurs usages

  • Comprendre les flux de données entre les différentes équipes

  • Identifier les redondances, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration

  • Participer à la conception du modèle de données cible

  • Contribuer, le cas échéant, à la migration progressive vers Supabase

  • Structurer les données financières, impact et ESG

  • Définir les règles d’accès et de gouvernance des données

  • Documenter les modèles, processus et bonnes pratiques

L’objectif est de construire un socle de données fiable, partagé et durable.

2. Automatiser les processus clés

Une fois les données structurées, vous contribuerez à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à fluidifier les opérations.

Exemples :

  • Collecte de données auprès des participations, relances automatiques

  • Consolidation de reportings

  • Contrôles de cohérence

  • Gestion documentaire

  • Préparation de certains livrables réglementaires

  • Qualification et enrichissement automatique d'opportunités d'investissement

  • Circulation de l’information entre les outils

Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de workflows no-code et low-code, principalement via N8N et les APIs des différents outils utilisés par la société.

3. Déployer des usages IA concrets

Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui saura identifier où l’IA peut réellement créer de la valeur.

Vous pourrez notamment travailler sur :

  • Des assistants internes connectés à nos bases de données

  • Des outils de recherche documentaire et de gestion des connaissances

  • L'extraction automatique d'informations depuis des rapports, questionnaires ou documents de due diligence

  • La pré-analyse de dossiers d'investissement

  • La génération assistée de reportings, mémos d’investissement et comptes-rendus

  • Des workflows mêlant automatisation et IA

  • L’exploration de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’investissement, à l’impact ou à la conformité

Vous serez encouragé.e à expérimenter, comparer les solutions disponibles sur le marché et proposer vos propres idées.

4. Construire les interfaces et portails utilisateurs

À mesure que les fondations seront en place, vous participerez à la création des interfaces permettant aux différents utilisateurs d’accéder simplement à l’information. Cela pourra inclure :

Portail équipe de gestion

  • Suivi des participations

  • Reporting portefeuille

  • Outils internes de pilotage

Portail investisseurs (LPs)

  • Consultation des reportings

  • Suivi des indicateurs de portefeuille

  • Diffusion sécurisée des informations réglementaires

Portail participations

  • Collecte de données

  • Suivi des indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers

  • Partage documentaire

5. Accompagner l’adoption des nouveaux outils

La réussite du projet ne dépend pas uniquement de la technologie. Vous contribuerez également à :

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs

  • Identifier de nouveaux cas d’usage

  • Former les équipes aux outils déployés

  • Produire une documentation simple et utile

  • Diffuser les bonnes pratiques liées à la data et à l’IA

  • Réaliser une veille active sur les nouveaux outils et tendances du marché

Pourquoi ce stage est différent

Vous ne rejoindrez pas une équipe technique isolée mais travaillerez directement avec les équipes métiers :

  • Notre Responsable Conformité & Middle Office

  • Notre Chief Impact Officer

  • Nos Directeur.rices d’investissement

Vous serez exposé.e à des problématiques à la fois stratégiques, opérationnelles et technologiques.

Vous participerez à la transformation d’une société de gestion de l’intérieur, avec une forte autonomie et un impact visible dès les premières semaines.

Les outils et processus que vous contribuerez à construire seront utilisés au quotidien par les équipes, les investisseurs et les entreprises que nous accompagnons.

C’est une opportunité rare de développer une expertise à l’intersection de l’investissement, de la data, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle.

Candidature

Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes expliquant :

  • Ce qui vous attire dans ce projet

  • Un outil, une automatisation ou un usage IA que vous avez déjà mis en place (ou que vous aimeriez explorer)

Pas besoin de lettre de motivation formelle.

Nous privilégions les personnes curieuses, pragmatiques et motivées à construire.


Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse, autonome et orientée solutions.

Vous pourriez être la bonne personne si :

  • Vous êtes en école d’ingénieur, école de commerce, université ou équivalent

  • Vous avez une forte appétence pour la data, l’automatisation et l’IA 

  • Vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux outils

  • Vous êtes capable de transformer un problème métier en solution concrète

  • Vous savez avancer de manière autonome tout en travaillant en équipe

Des compétences ou expériences dans les domaines suivants seront appréciées :

  • SQL et bases de données relationnelles

  • Airtable, Notion, N8N, Make ou outils similaires

  • APIs et intégrations

  • IA générative et prompting

Mais nous accordons autant d’importance à la curiosité, à la capacité d’apprentissage et à l’esprit d’initiative qu’aux compétences techniques.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

Push into generative UI

  • Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

  • Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

  • Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

  • You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

title: Head of Electronics & software
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

  • Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

  • Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

  • Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

  • Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

  • Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

  • Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

  • Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

  • Build clear development and technical career paths

  • Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

  • Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

  • Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

  • Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

You will help define how excellent electronics and software engineering is done across the company.

This includes:

  • Owning and continuously improving engineering practices across electronics, software, GNC and electrical/harness engineering

  • Establishing practical standards for electronics design, software development, testing, modelling, reviews and verification

  • Ensuring teams understand and can effectively apply the relevant processes

  • Supporting certification readiness, audits and continuous improvement, including applicable EN9100 requirements

  • Working closely with Quality, Safety, Systems Engineering and the Chief Engineer organisation

  • Using lessons from development, testing and operations to continuously improve engineering practices

Our aim is not process for process's sake. We want processes that are lean, pragmatic and proportionate to engineering risk.

Engineering Tools & Ways of Working

You will ensure our engineers have the tools and engineering environment needed to work effectively and at scale.

This includes capability across:

  • Electronics and PCB design

  • Harness CAD

  • Software development, build and configuration toolchains

  • Automated testing

  • GNC analysis and modelling

  • Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

  • Simulation and shared test infrastructure

You will drive standardisation, adoption and good engineering practice while partnering with Digital, IT, Procurement, Quality and other engineering teams.

The goal is simple: engineering work should be efficient, traceable, reproducible and ready to scale.

Project Support & Resource Planning

You will work closely with our projects to ensure they have access to the Electronics & Software capability they need.

You will:

  • Mentor engineering Leads and provide senior technical guidance where needed

  • Support major technical and engineering reviews

  • Maintain visibility of capability gaps, resource constraints and significant engineering risks

  • Work with project leadership to resolve resource requirements through hiring, development, internal mobility or external support

  • Anticipate future capacity constraints before they become programme blockers

  • Help resolve cross-project resource and organisational conflicts

  • Contribute to the company-wide electronics and software strategy alongside the Chief of Engineering and CTO

  • Shape future capabilities, reusable technologies, R&D priorities and obsolescence strategies

Budget

You will own the Electronics & Software functional budget and forecast, including:

  • Headcount and personnel planning

  • Engineering tools and licences

  • Relevant shared simulation and test capability

  • Training and development

  • Functional team travel

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Digital and project leadership to ensure investment supports both immediate programme needs and longer-term engineering capability.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who combines credible engineering depth with proven organisational leadership.

You should bring:

  • Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of the following: avionics, electronics, embedded systems, flight software, GNC or electrical systems

  • Enough technical breadth to operate effectively across several of these disciplines and understand how they interact

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a complex product environment

  • Proven formal line-management experience, including developing managers and technical leaders

  • Experience hiring, developing and building engineering organisations

  • Experience with organisational design, workforce and capacity planning

  • Experience creating or improving engineering processes, tools, standards and ways of working

  • Experience operating within a matrix organisation and supporting multiple projects or programmes

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, communication and influencing skills

  • The technical credibility to challenge senior engineers while empowering the appropriate technical owners to make decisions

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering quality, assurance and compliance, including relevant EN9100 practices

Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, aerospace, defence, aviation, robotics or another complex safety-critical engineering environment would be particularly relevant.

We are looking for a leader who:

  • Leads with high standards, humility and low ego

  • Enjoys developing people rather than simply directing them

  • Empowers strong technical Leads and avoids becoming a bottleneck

  • Can challenge experienced engineers constructively

  • Makes decisions using data and sound engineering judgement

  • Balances immediate programme pressures with long-term organisational capability

  • Creates clarity where responsibilities cross organisational boundaries

  • Promotes transparency, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning

  • Believes in extreme ownership and engineering first principles

  • Remains close enough to the engineering to understand the challenges our teams are solving

Location & Travel

This is a leadership role with teams and stakeholders across our European organisation, so regular face-to-face engagement is important.

You should expect to spend time across our main European sites, with additional travel where required for team leadership, recruitment, major engineering reviews, audits and project support.

  • A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

  • Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

  • Growth: Take responsibility from day one and develop through regular feedback, workshops, and knowledge exchanges.

What You’ll Bring

· Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements.

· Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance.

· Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners.

· Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%).

What We Offer

· The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA.

· The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business.

· Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Account Executive for Southern Europe, you'll build NetBird's business in France, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece, with France as your anchor market. Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. You own the full cycle, from first touch to signed contract and expansion. You'll report to our Head of Sales and work closely with our Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle in Southern Europe: prospecting, discovery, demos with a Solutions Engineer, proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Turn open source and self-serve users into paying annual customers, using product usage signals to find the right accounts and the right moment.

  • Run outbound into mid-market and enterprise companies that want to replace legacy VPNs such as OpenVPN, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet or GlobalProtect.

  • Sell to technical buyers, from infrastructure and network engineers to security leads, with a clear story on open source, self-hosting and zero trust.

  • Build relationships with MSPs, integrators and resellers across the region.

  • Meet customers on site, at conferences and at meetups, and join the team in Berlin for regular offsites.

  • Keep your forecast and HubSpot data accurate, and bring regional product and pricing feedback back to the team.

  • Shape messaging for French-speaking markets with Marketing, including compliance and data sovereignty topics such as NIS2, GDPR and SecNumCloud.

This is a builder role: you'll be the first person dedicated to the region, with a lot of freedom in how you build it and room to grow as the team expands.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for a French-speaking Account Executive who loves selling technical products and has built a territory from little or nothing. If you've sold commercial open source, developer-led or security products into France and Southern Europe, we'd especially love to hear from you.

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years closing new business as an Account Executive in B2B software, with a track record of hitting quota.

  • Experience selling networking, security, infrastructure or DevOps software, for example VPN, ZTNA or SASE, identity, firewall or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with an open source, product-led or freemium model, and turning free users into paying customers.

  • Comfortable discussing WireGuard, VPN vs. zero trust, SSO and identity provider integration, Kubernetes and self-hosting with engineers.

  • A structured qualification approach such as MEDDPICC.

  • Native French, and able to run discovery, negotiations and executive meetings in French.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Self-directed and organised when working remotely, and happy to travel regularly across the region and to Berlin.

  • You work AI native. You use AI tools every day, for example to research accounts, prepare discovery calls or draft outreach, and you know where they help and where they don't.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Spanish, Italian or Portuguese.

  • Experience as the first or second Account Executive in a new region at a startup.

  • An existing network of IT and security leaders in France, Spain or Italy.

  • Experience with channel partners, MSPs or public sector procurement.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: The region is yours. You build your own pipeline, own your number, and fix what's in the way instead of waiting for it to be fixed.

  • Default to candor: You forecast honestly, call out deals that aren't real early, and tell customers clearly what NetBird does and doesn't do.

  • Stay close to the user: You know our product well enough to have credible conversations with engineers, and you bring what customers say back to the team.

😌 What's in it for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary and equity.

  • Attractive commission plan with no cap on variable pay.

  • Fully remote within the region (+/-1 Central European Time), with regular time with the team in Berlin.

  • Build a region from day one: real ownership of the territory, and room to grow as we expand our sales team.

  • Close collaboration with our Head of Sales, Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, and health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass).

If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

title: Technical Program Manager (AI/ML)
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation.   • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work.

  • Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are.

  • Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base.

 

You might be a fit if

  • You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work.

  • You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product.

  • You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why.

  • You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does.
